summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term SPX upside, evidenced by massive $2.1B in BuyCall premium and heavy accumulation of 7000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2027. Significant directional conviction is visible in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C (exps 2026/2027) totaling billions in premium, alongside massive $186M+ bets on SPXW 8140C/8150C for late 2026. While there is large-scale hedging via SPX 8000P (exp 2027), the sheer scale of the 7000C and 7800C call buying suggests a dominant long-term upward bias. Traders should watch for SPX price action near the 7000 level and monitor if the heavy semiconductor call flow in NVDA ($141.5M) and AMD ($264.3M) translates into momentum in the tech sector.
